params.amount: The native USDC amount to borrow.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.totalCycles: Number of cycles to pre-authorize (e.g. 5 or 10 cycles).

borrowAgainstTurn(uint256).notice: Borrow native USDC liquidity against the member's guaranteed future payout turn.         The smart contract locks future payout rights and auto-garnishes upon their turn.

buyShares(uint256).notice: Acquire additional shares in the cooperative pool.         Each additional share grants an additional scheduled payout turn in the cycle rotation!

cancelAutoSaveSubscription().notice: Cancel an active auto-save subscription anytime and immediately refund 100% of remaining stash.

deposit().notice: Deposit the required cycle contribution in native USDC.         On Arc Mainnet, USDC is native gas & native currency (msg.value).         Supports flexible advance pre-funding: excess deposit is buffered in advanceBalance!

depositAdvance().notice: Fund an advance balance in native USDC.         Enables savers to pre-pay multiple cycles ahead so they never miss a deadline.

depositBoosterSavings().notice: Deposit voluntary flexible savings into the cooperative's float yield strategy.         Allows members to save beyond the fixed rotating pot and earn compounding float yield.

depositFromAdvanceFor(address).notice: Settle a member's current cycle contribution using their buffered advance balance.         Can be invoked by the member or any group participant before or at deadline.

distributePatronageDividends(uint256).notice: Distribute surplus profits (from 2% loan fees, auction discounts, and float yield)         from the reserveFund back to active cooperative members as an annual or season patronage dividend!

distributePayout().notice: Distribute the pool payout to the scheduled cycle beneficiary.         Can be executed once cycle deadline passes OR all members deposited.

executeAutoDebit(address).notice: Settle an auto-debit on behalf of a subscribed member when a new cycle is active.         Can be triggered by an automated bot/keeper, the cycle beneficiary, or any group peer.

getAutoSaveStatus(address).notice: View auto-save subscription details for any member.

getCurrentBeneficiary().notice: Get current beneficiary (accounting for active auction bid).

getCycleInSeason().notice: Get cycle number within the current season (1-indexed).

getMemberFinancials(address).notice: Get comprehensive personal financial position for a member.

harvestYield().notice: Harvest accrued yield from the external strategy into reserve.

joinPool().notice: Join the cooperative savings pool queue.

repayLoan().notice: Manually repay an active loan early.

setupAutoSaveSubscription(uint256).notice: Set up an automated recurring savings subscription.         Locks a prefunded stash of native USDC specifically dedicated to auto-debiting         upcoming cycles on autopilot without manual transaction signing!

submitTurnBid(uint256).notice: Submit a discount bid to receive an immediate cycle payout advance.         The highest bidder receives the pot minus their discount.         The discount is immediately distributed as dividends to patient savers!

withdrawBoosterSavings(uint256).notice: Withdraw voluntary booster savings on demand.
